sentences.en: First conceived by the psychologist Leon Festinger,
sentences.zh: 这一理论最初由心理学家利昂·费斯廷格提出，

sentences.en: and then developed by Elliot Aronson when he was Leon Festinger's student,
sentences.zh: 后来由埃利奥特·阿伦森在他担任费斯廷格学生时进一步发展，

sentences.en: the theory suggests it is difficult to hold contrasting or dissonant thoughts inside our heads.
sentences.zh: 该理论认为，我们的头脑中很难同时容纳相互矛盾或不协调的想法。

sentences.en: In the parable, the fox wants the grapes, but it cannot get them.
sentences.zh: 在寓言中，狐狸想要葡萄，但它得不到。

sentences.en: So the fox changes whether it wanted the grapes in the first place.

sentences.en: It tells itself the grapes were not really desirable.
sentences.zh: 它告诉自己，这些葡萄其实并不值得想要。

sentences.en: Elliot says the same thing happens in every domain of our lives.
sentences.zh: 埃利奥特说，同样的事情发生在我们生活的每一个领域。
